primary_estimand: Probability of any rejection among markers conditionally independent of failure time given clinical z; under partial nulls, the 25 null residuals are independent of the 5 causal marker residuals.
secondary_estimands: power among the five true markers under partial nulls
interpretation: A fixed simulation stress test, not universal error control. Raw permutation and a prespecified z-squared clinical term are sensitivity analyses. A wider clinical basis is not automatically introduced into production. Do not select a method using these outcomes and describe the same seed as independent validation.
failure_policy: Record every planned replicate. Report invalid counts and FWER bounds treating failures as all non-rejections or all rejections. A failed run is not a calibration pass.

data_generation.marker_residuals: standard normal; correlated_null has a common factor with pairwise residual correlation 0.7
data_generation.failure_hazard: 0.06*exp(0.8*z + beta*sum(first five marker residuals)); beta is 0, 0.2, or 0.4
data_generation.censor_hazard: 0.04, or 0.04*exp(0.8*z) in covariate_dependent_censoring; conditionally independent of failure given z and marker residuals
